prathamakamitarajaparivr̥ttaṁ । yadi ca bhavati turyam ॥ caraṇayugamaparamapi bhavati yathāsvaṁ । dvigurunidhanamakhilamiha gaditamiti kalikākhyā
dvitayamapi ca yadi parivr̥ttam । caraṇa iha salalitayatiratha tr̥tīyaḥ ॥ tamanu bhavati cādyō dvidaśakanidhanajacaraṇaparipaṭhitalavalī sā

kriyatē’tha saṁprati tr̥tīya— caraṇagatalakṣmarūpaṇam ॥ naubhagāvapi hi saurabhakaṁ yadi cōdgatāsadr̥śamēva śēṣakam
dvitayaṁ nayōratha sayōśca । bhavati caraṇē tr̥tīyakē ॥ prasr̥tapadaracanayā lalitaṁ । lalitaṁ ca nāma tadihābhiniścitam
msau jbhau gau ca turīyamēkataḥ pr̥thaganyat । tritayaṁ sanajaragēṣu nau sayuktau ॥ atha nayutananajayāḥ । pracupitamanugaditamupasthitapūrvam
nau snau nāccē paraṁ sakāramāha tr̥tīyē । prathamātpr̥thagaparēṇa vardhamānam ॥ pracupitasadr̥śakamanyadiha bhavati śakalaṁ । pratiniyatacaraṇagatalakṣmavidhānam
